message.content: Based on the data provided, Quillan mentions that Brienne of Tarth was a game-changer for Cersei, noting that their journey together really forced Cersei to confront who she wanted to be versus who she was. This led to significant character development and transformation for Cersei. Specifically, Quillan suggests that Brienne’s influence brought out the honor and humanity in Jaime Lannister that had not been previously seen, and that this connection with Brienne brought out similar qualities in Cersei, forcing her to question her own values and actions.
